title: 100x SubhanAllah wa biHamdihi
sources: Sahih al-Bukhari 6405: Narrated Abu Huraira: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'Whoever says, SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi, one hundred times a day, will be forgiven all his sins even if they were as much as the foam of the sea.'

lines.text: say SubhanAllahi wa biHamdihi one hundred times with us.
lines.caps: say | SubhanAllahi | wa biHamdihi | 100 times | with us.

lines.text: Watch every drop of heavy seafoam turn into radiant pearls.
lines.caps: Watch | every drop | of seafoam | turn into | radiant pearls.

lines.text: SubhanAllahi wa biHamdihi. Glory be to Allah and His is the praise.
lines.caps: SubhanAllahi | wa biHamdihi | Glory be to Allah

lines.text: The Prophet peace be upon him said:
lines.caps: The Prophet | peace be upon him | said:

lines.text: Whoever says SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi one hundred times a day,
lines.caps: Whoever says | SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi | 100 times | a day,

lines.text: will have all their sins forgiven,
lines.caps: will have | all their sins | forgiven,

lines.text: even if they were as much as the foam of the sea.
lines.caps: even if | they were as much | as the foam | of the sea.

lines.text: Save this, and say it again tomorrow.
lines.caps: Save this, | and say it | again | tomorrow.
